scope: Source-backed layer adaptation of Yayon et al. Fig. 3f; unpublished dendrogram topology/heights omitted, so not full-panel equivalence
review_method: Opened the reference and candidate PNGs, then opened actual PDF and SVG renderings at 96 dpi (794×420 px). Inspected final physical proportions and separately checked actual exported PDF/PNG metadata. No implementation code/tests or prior review were read.
observations: Two aligned 65-column by 10-row matrices appear in Fetal then Paediatric order; shared columns continue through the cosine bars and zero-line P circles.
Both heatmaps use the visible 0–1 viridis guide; the middle bars and continuous guide cover −1 to +1 with a zero baseline.
CCL21, CCL19, CXCL12 and CCL25 labels are orange; outlined spans are CCL13–CX3CL1 and IL34–TGFB3. The boxes stop above the upper matrix and do not imply a reconstructed tree.
The three hollow-circle classes are visibly distinct and agree with the increasing-area legend; bars are filled without incidental dark outlines.
Row labels, left group dividers, compact P legend and expression guide remain readable and subordinate to the matrix regions. No clipping or collisions were visible in the PDF/PNG views.

findings.location: SVG heatmap cell boundaries at 96 dpi
findings.evidence: The librsvg 96 dpi rendering shows faint cell-boundary seams; the matching PDF and PNG renderings do not show this grid. The seams do not alter cell colors, order or layer alignment.
findings.requirement: The two matrices should use the adopted filled-cell appearance consistently across exports.
findings.action: Prefer the inspected PDF/PNG for assembly. If SVG is the delivery format, check the intended application and suppress rasterization seams if they persist.

findings.evidence: All 65 italic gene labels are visible, including the four orange labels. At 210 mm width, each column is approximately 2.6 mm wide; the labels are dense but separately traceable in the final-size PDF/PNG views.
findings.requirement: Keep all adopted genes and Arial 7.5 pt at the frozen panel dimensions.
findings.action: Retain the adopted dimensions/font. Use the vector PDF or 300 dpi PNG for final assembly; do not shrink this panel or its text.

findings.evidence: Sub-Capsular is displayed as Subcapsular; Medullar is displayed as Medullary. The dendrogram and source panel letter are intentionally absent. The corrected final caption states that the unpublished tree was not reproduced and full-panel equivalence is not claimed.
findings.requirement: Honor the adopted aliases, manuscript text convention and bounded reproduction scope.
findings.action: Retain these declared adaptations and the separate source-attributed caption.

resolved_findings.initial_evidence: The initial candidate carried the synthetic transfer caption.
resolved_findings.resolution: The final output caption now describes the source-backed Yayon Fig. 3f adaptation, supplied summaries, display aliases and omitted dendrogram/full-panel limitation. Pixel exports are unchanged by this caption repair.

external_checks.check: Actual PDF typography and font embedding

evidence.embedding: pdffonts reports every ArialMT/Arial-ItalicMT subset embedded (Type 3).

evidence.interpretation: 2480×1311 pixels at approximately 300 dpi; integer-pixel dimensions agree with the declared 210×111 mm canvas within raster rounding.

external_checks.check: Source values, exact per-cell/per-bar numbers and upstream statistics
external_checks.evidence: This independent visual review did not read source tables, plotting code, tests, numeric QA or previous reviews. It validates visible mappings and actual exports; it does not recalculate normalization, cosine, ANOVA, P correction or dendrogram.

baseline_preference.reason: The main panel is an adopted reference-layer reproduction and the transfer is an unrelated fixed-layout example. No claimed refinement or aesthetic superiority over an accepted baseline was evaluated.

unresolved_items: SVG antialiasing seams depend on the receiving application.
Numerical/source correctness remains outside this independent image-only review.
